Insignia audit: one arm per faction, in every rotation (V3, 2026-10-27)

The CEO: some enemies (the Colossus, the General and others) wear the armband on the right in some pictures and on the left in others, and sometimes it is the Nazi one, sometimes the US one. Cause. gemini_enemy.py makes rotations 6-8 by mirroring 4-2, and turns every side view Gemini drew facing right into a left-facing one by mirroring it too: a mirror moves an insignia to the other arm. Gemini also drew the General with the US flag where his armband goes in half of his views (front, profile, back). The «Colossus» with the Nazi armband is the Chrome Marshal: the General's own sprites tinted chrome (D123).

The rule (proposed and applied)

  • Reich: the armband on the left upper arm.
  • Legion: the US flag patch on the right shoulder (as Gemini drew the trooper and the gunner).
  • The General (both insignia, the alliance's commander): the armband on his left arm, the US flag on his right.
  • The Chrome Marshal (a Legion boss): the General's pictures with the armband replaced by the US flag, as a new sprite SDCM; the General's SDGN stays as it is.
  • The Consortium: Reich half on its left, Legion half on its right (already built so, its own rotations 6-8).
  • Bodies mirrored with the rotation (the stormtrooper's machine arm, the Colossus's torch and tablet) keep the insignia on the limb Gemini drew it on: moving it would put an armband on the machine arm or the flag on the torch arm. Reported in amber, not repainted; the exact fix is a Gemini sheet of their other side (as for the Consortium).

wrong arm or kind off the faction's arm, body mirrored (not repainted)repainted

Rotations: 1 front, 2-4 turning to the viewer's left, 5 back, 6-8 turning to the viewer's right. Labels name the character's own arm. — = no insignia found (the arm is turned away, or it is only a few pixels).

How the repaint is made

At Gemini's resolution, before the reduction and before the D108 symbol (tools/art/insignia_fix.py, through a hook in gemini_enemy.build): a misplaced insignia is erased (refilled from the sleeve round it) and pasted, flipped, on the right arm: whole on the near arm, its edge on the far arm of a 3/4 view, not at all where the body hides it (the far arm of a profile). The General's insignia swap in place (the armband from his 3/4 front, the flag from his profile). The Reich armbands then get the symbol from armband_symbol.py as the approved ones did. Every other pixel and every canvas is the approved set's: a lump with no repaint comes out byte-identical and is not reinstalled. Nothing is installed: the lumps wait in work/art/insignia_fix/lumps/ with install.sh, for the CEO's OK.
